notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array five times by removing five charge counters from it, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.
